whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Duggu Bakery and Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has a solid 4.1★ rating on Bank Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for birthday cake orders and table reservations.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, menu showcase, aur instant location navigation integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://duggubakery-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Duggu Bakery and Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake booking and a mobile-friendly menu showcase for your location on Bank Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact bakery items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
